text:
maria.chen: heads up, spotted a sustained rise in Pending GPU pods in spot-pool-asia-mix :eyes:
kevin.patel: saw that too, most pods are nodeAffinity=a100-only but current spot nodes are mostly rtx6000-family after yesterday's reprovisioning
jon.s: any chance CA is scaling the wrong nodegroup? we've got heterogeneous instance types in the same pool which confuses binpacking
maria.chen: yep, CA is happily adding rtx6000 nodes because they are cheaper/available; scheduler then can't schedule a100-only pods -> they stay Pending and rack up latency
priya: hmm, why are pods pinned to a100? I thought model-serving uses generic gpu label, not specific series
jon.s: some older rollout used nodeSelector: gpu-type: a100 to enforce memory, and we never cleaned it up for a subset of retrain jobs
maria.chen: repro steps/logs: `kubectl get pods -n models -o wide | grep Pending` shows affinity in pod spec, e.g.
```
nodeAffinity:
  requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    nodeSelectorTerms:
    - matchExpressions:
      - key: gpu-type
        operator: In
        values:
        - a100-80g
```
kevin.patel: CA config: `--node-group-auto-discovery=asg:tag=k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled,k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/cluster:redwood-prod` and autoscaler is group-level, not per-gpu-class
priya: proposal: 1) stop mixing heterogeneous instance types into the same autoscaling group 2) add node-group priorities/expander so CA prefers a100 group for a100-pinned pods 3) create a small on-demand warm pool (2 nodes/region) as fallback for scheduling-critical jobs
maria.chen: agree. also need a short-term workaround: update the model retrain job spec to remove strict nodeAffinity so it can run on rtx6000 (memory ok for smaller batches)
kevin.patel: I can patch the autoscaler to use `priority`/`balance` expander and split the ASGs. will also add a spot to on-demand fallback policy in the scaling policy (keep 2 on-demand nodes per zone).
jon.s: add a diagnostic dashboard metric to track "Pending_due_to_node_affinity" label so we detect this faster next time
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1342 - "spot-pool instance-type mix causing schedule fragmentation" assigned to eng-infra
priya: cost note: warm on-demand nodes ~+6% infra spend but reduces retries and failed jobs; run impact analysis if needed
maria.chen: short action list: (1) kevin split spot pool into spot-a100 / spot-rtx (2) kevin add CA expander & priority (3) kevin add fallback warm-pool 2 nodes/region (4) jon create the dashboard alert (5) maria send cleanup PR to remove stale nodeSelector from retrain jobs
kevin.patel: I'll start with CA changes and ASG split. ETA 3 hours for config, 12 hours for warm-pool provisioning across zones. will post progress here :thumbsup:
maria.chen: thanks — after CA change we'll run a controlled deploy of retrain job on staging to validate scheduling
jon.s: leaving a quick note: once split, also consider taints on a100 nodes + tolerations for jobs that truly require them, avoids accidental placement
priya: ack, will document tradeoffs in infra-runbook (cost, availability, failover)
maria.chen: closing loop: if anyone sees Pending > 10min for GPU pods ping here or escalate to INC-2026-1342
kevin.patel: update: CA config patched, rolling out now. logs:
```
I0323 14:05:12 autoscaler.go:... Expander set to priority, nodeGroup spot-a100 preferred for label gpu-type=a100
```
kevin.patel: will report back when warm-pool is up
